title: Dillard's (DDS) Trend-Right Merchandise Strategy Favors Stock - Zacks Investment Research
description: Dillard's has maintained its position in the market by focusing on trendy products and exceptional customer service. The company's strategic initiatives in physical stores and e-commerce, along with efficient inventory management, have driven its performance. Despite facing a challenging retail environment, Dillard's resilience and adaptability have positioned it strongly in the competitive landscape.

title: 3 Solid Dividend Stocks Worth Owning Amid Unprecedented Market Volatility
description: The article recommends three dividend-paying stocks - Prudential Financial, Diamondback Energy, and Dillard's - as attractive investments during the current market volatility due to their strong fundamentals, consistent dividend payouts, and growth potential.

title: Macy's Up 1.1% Since Last Earnings Report: Can It Continue?
description: Macy's reported mixed Q2 2024 results, with revenue missing estimates but earnings beating. The company revised its annual outlook to account for cautious consumers and a more intense promotional environment. Macy's continues to focus on strategic initiatives to improve customer experience and maintain profitability.

title: Lulus Joins Forces With Dillard’s in Strategic U.S. Wholesale Expansion
description: Lulus, an attainable luxury fashion brand, has announced a strategic collaboration with Dillard's, one of the nation's largest fashion retailers. This partnership will bring Lulus' latest special occasion and event apparel collections to over 30 Dillard's stores nationwide, expanding the brand's distribution and reaching new audiences.

title: Dillard’s Introduces Darby Fallon Clark for Edgehill
description: Dillard's has launched a limited-edition children's apparel, accessories, and footwear collection in partnership with Atlanta-based tastemaker Darby Fallon Clark. The Edgehill collection features traditional looks with holiday elegance, inspired by Clark's personal experiences and family.

title: Dillard's, Inc. Announces Special Dividend of $25.00 Per Share and Quarterly Cash Dividend of $0.25 Per Share
description: Dillard's, Inc. announced a special dividend of $25.00 per share and a quarterly cash dividend of $0.25 per share, rewarding shareholders, particularly its associates who are also shareholders.
